name: Streptozocin

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for kidney harm, blood problems and cancer risk

examples.title: Avastin, Fluorouracil, Doxorubicin and Streptozocin in Locally Advanced and Metastatic Pancreatic Endocrine Tumors
examples.why: Development of new chemotherapy standard of care for treatment rendered the trial obsolete.

summary: In the United States, Streptozocin carries a boxed warning for kidney damage (nephrotoxicity), blood-related harm (hematological harm), and the potential to cause cancer (carcinogenicity) [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a low score for liver harm [M]. The same computer model, also not tested on humans, gave it a low score for heart harm as well [M].
